note: Rewritten from Emerson's Kartabo termite monograph, original in English. S. trispinosus was originally described by Silvestri (1903); the present account follows Emerson's description and comparison of the Kartabo material. The original gives the measurements in two groups (the row labels of the second group are OCR-corrupted, e.g. "Peat neater" for Width of head and "SWAG RNalu(aving…" for Width of pronotum), restored here from the values and row order. The original describes the soldier only; the worker is not described.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier with 8 points on the frontal prominence, the lateral points smaller than the median point; mandibles black, smooth except for the basal tooth; head subrectangular, sides straight and parallel. The author notes that the Kartabo specimens do not fully agree with S. trispinosus as recorded by Silvestri (1903) (the latter has a wider head and a larger ratio of the lateral points of the frontal prominence), and considers that M. nigrostomus Holmgren may be conspecific; it differs from M. gracilis Holmgren in the shorter frontal prominence and in the labrum being concave at the apex without a raised central part.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, darker anteriorly; with a few short setae; subrectangular, sides straight and parallel, posterior margin rounded. Antennae 14-segmented, slightly darker than the head. Labrum slightly darker than the head, wide, with 2 points. Mandibles black, slightly curved, smooth except for the basal tooth. Nasus sometimes upturned at the apex, hairy, with 8 points, the lateral points smaller than the median point. Thorax pale, anterior margin of the pronotum rounded. Legs pale. Abdominal tergites pale, with short hairs and a few setae. Measurements: total length 5.00—7.00 mm, head length 2.75—3.00 mm; second set of measurements: head length (without mandibles) 1.86—2.12 mm, head width 1.08—1.26 mm, antennal length 1.50—1.90 mm, pronotum width 0.68 mm, hind tibia length 0.97 mm, left mandible length 1.51 mm.
